verification_process.allowed_checker: only separately pinned configured read-only native checker

deterministic_checks.on_unavailable: not_run; never substitute a JSON-shape pass for native validation

factual_observations.expectation: Body and checklist guide review of local Orchard notes and their local evidence, returning findings without modifying notes absent separate authority.
factual_observations.method: independent artifact review against cited source; accept equivalent meaning, not token matching

factual_observations.expectation: Review identifies reader and observable behavior, distinguishes delivered versus planned, requires implementation evidence for delivered changes and separate pass/fail/not_run test evidence. Missing test evidence cannot become pass.
factual_observations.method: independent artifact review against cited source; accept equivalent meaning, not token matching

factual_observations.expectation: Planned changes require owner and next checkpoint; unresolved or inaccessible local evidence is reported, not fabricated. Links stay inside the project.
factual_observations.method: independent artifact review against cited source; accept equivalent meaning, not token matching

factual_observations.expectation: Examples demonstrate review criteria and are not reported as verified facts; remote credentials or confidential attachments are not prerequisites.
factual_observations.method: independent artifact review against cited source; accept equivalent meaning, not token matching

factual_observations.expectation: Clear narrow selection and ordinary-edit exclusion; no installation, sending, automatic activation or self-granted tools; validation and benefit claims reflect actual receipts only.
factual_observations.method: independent artifact review against cited source; accept equivalent meaning, not token matching

completeness: No usable native package or local review workflow is supplied.
Major package element or central delivered/planned/evidence convention is missing or wrong.
Package and central convention are complete, with a minor guidance detail needing correction.
All three native artifacts are coherent and bounded; guidance covers audience/behavior, states, local implementation/test evidence, planned owner/checkpoint, unavailable evidence and exclusions.
clarity: Future reader cannot understand what to review or how to use the package.
Body and checklist conflict, bury selection criteria or require major interpretation.
Selection, workflow and checklist are understandable with a small duplication or wording issue.
Body explains when and how to use the linked checklist; checklist presents actionable review decisions with no conflicting examples or invented project claims.
usefulness: Following the package invents evidence, grants authority or produces irrelevant findings.
Reviewer must redesign the guidance to apply the supplied project convention.
Reviewer can apply the convention reliably with a minor clarification or lookup.
A future reviewer can turn a supplied note and evidence into specific findings for delivered/planned claims, missing evidence and scope without inventing rules or relying on fixture-only examples.

grading: Hard gates and reader dimensions are separate. Score each dimension independently, including baseline failures. A score never overrides a failed or not_run hard gate.
